scope: Dominant-component matching crops without modifying rendering masks
Two observations per shot; third for disagreement, absence, or weak scores
Unchanged 0.0446 acceptance cutoff; 0.20 triggers an additional check only
Existing request/lifetime budget and review/no-review contracts retained
Saved evidence frames, raw scores, crop geometry and fragment counts
exclusions: Deployment, queues, capacity, auth and provider configuration

verification.extension_impact: No extension contract surface files changed

known_limitations: More matching requests may consume the unchanged 120-request allowance sooner.
The previously observed Wrong Angle bystander false match remains at the user-selected experimental cutoff.
Conflicting or insufficient evidence follows the existing review/no-review policy; crop cleanup does not repair fragmented SAM tracks.
